name: Garudoma -Joshiryou no Kanrinin- After
original_name: ガルドマ-女子寮の管理人-After
source:
The Harem at the Prestigious Girls' Dormitory Isn’t Over Yet!
What started as a random incident at the girls' dormitory involving Natsumi Rin, Akishima Hiyori, and Fuyusaki Aiko—along with the protagonist, Kitagami Haruto—turned into something far more complicated. Surprisingly, their relationships didn’t fall apart. If anything, they grew stronger.

However, their dynamic was something that could never be made public. For a while, it remained a secret shared among the four of them, quietly enjoyed behind closed doors. But… teenage girls in that kind of situation aren’t exactly known for their patience. Little by little, things began escalating in a bolder direction!

[Translated from [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/garudoma-after/story.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
名门女生宿舍的后宫还没有结束！
夏海凛、秋岛日和、冬崎爱子以及主角北上晴人在女生宿舍发生的一起随机事件，后来却变得更加复杂。令人惊讶的是，他们的关系并没有破裂。如果说有什么不同的话，那就是他们变得更强大了。

然而，他们的动态是永远不能公开的。有一段时间，这仍然是他们四个人共享的秘密，闭门静静地享受着。但是……在这种情况下，十几岁的女孩并不以耐心着称。渐渐地，事情开始朝着更大胆的方向升级！

[翻译自[url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/garudoma-after/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
